items.title: File Widerspruch against denial of Krankengeld
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, sent by simple post. Per the letter's own clause, a letter sent by simple post 'gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben' (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X): 27.01.2026 + 4 days = Sat 31.01.2026, deemed delivery (this day itself does not shift for social-law delivery fiction). The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 84 Abs. 1 SGG) starts the next day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X): 01.02.2026. One month later (§ 188 Abs. 3 BGB) is Sat 28.02.2026. Since that is a Saturday, the deadline moves to the next business day under § 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 64 Abs. 3 SGG: Monday 02.03.2026.

warnings: The computed Widerspruch deadline (2026-03-02) has already passed as of today (2026-09-26); if the addressee has not already objected, they should seek advice on whether a late objection (Wiedereinsetzung in den vorigen Stand) or another remedy is still possible.

The letter states the sick-note ('Bescheinigung') was received on 22.01.2026, which is only 5 days before the letter's own date of 27.01.2026, but no evidence is given for the actual first day of incapacity or when it should have been reported — the underlying calculation by the insurer could not be independently verified from this letter alone.
